title: Getting in touch
subtitle: Suggestions, comments and links about the Bohemian Forest
description: Contact for the website of the new Tusset Chapel, and links to pages about the Bohemian Forest and the Bavarian Forest.

blocks.html: We, the sons of Emil Weber, are very glad to receive your suggestions and comments – especially from all Bohemian Forest Germans and their descendants who feel a connection to this website and who wish to preserve the history of the Bohemian Forest. We are happy to add links to our website that relate to this subject.
